doc.title: Crescent City Crystals: Dave Bailey, Harold Christophe, Albert Delone, Sylvester Handy Interview, 1963-11-13

chapter: Dave Bailey: recording and learning to play
title: An informal party recording with Mac Neal
summary: Bailey recalls a social tape made at a party with Mac Neal and others about a year and a half earlier; it was not a recording session and was never issued.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums
